newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Baboons ambush motorists on South African highway.
newsitem.headline: Baboons ambush motorists on South African highway.

text.p: Motorists on one of South Africa's busiest highways face a new wildlife hazard -- a troop of baboons who ambush them with showers of rocks.
Traffic officials said on Wednesday that three attacks had been reported in recent weeks on the highway between Cape Town and Johannesburg where it passes through a spectacular mountain pass.
They said no injuries or crashes had been caused yet, but stone-throwing traffic police had engaged in a running battle with the animals on Tuesday in a bid to drive them away.
